declarations.name: WebCounter
declarations.description: Renders a supplied page view count on rolling digits inside a shadow root.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: A decimal nonnegative safe integer. Starts blank until a valid count is supplied.

attributes.name: leading-zeros
attributes.description: Number of zero wheels before the count, from 0 through 16. An absent or invalid setting uses one.

slots.name: label
slots.description: Optional visible caption. Defaults to Page views.
